## Our Stores & Services

[ View All Services ][79]

### Financial Services

Discover how our comprehensive financial services, including payroll, accounts payable, tax
consulting and bookkeeping, help retailers save time and focus on growing their business.

[ About Financial Services ][80]

### Food Safety Services

As a food solutions company that has earned consumer trust for more than 107 years, C&S understands
the importance of having rigorous standards and training for food safety.

[ About Food Safety Services ][81]

### Marketing Services

C&S offers marketing support to elevate your brand, including cutting-edge technology and
industry-leading insights — all designed to enhance your promotional strategies, from digital
advertising to community engagement.

[ About Marketing Services ][82]

### Pharmacy Solutions

Our pharmacy services leverage collective buying power across 2,500 independent pharmacies to
guarantee lower operational costs for you and better health outcomes for the community you serve. 

[ About Pharmacy Solutions ][83]

### Our Stores

The C&S family of companies includes more than 200 grocery stores in 12 states, in addition to
dozens of pharmacies and fuel centers with convenience stores.

[ About Our Stores ][84]

### OurBrands

OurBrands are carried in company-operated stores and are distributed to our independent retail
customers — providing great products and great savings for every shopper and for every family.

[ About OurBrands ][85]

hunger to safeguarding the environment. We collaborate with organizations nationwide to make a

_crawl.about: C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC is a leader in food solutions across the United States. Established in 1918, C&S had its start as a supplier to independent grocery stores. Today, the C&S family of companies — including Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group™, Davidson Specialty Foods and SpartanNash® — delivers innovative supply chain solutions, products and services to chain, independent and military customers from 60 distribution centers nationwide. C&S offers a comprehensive range of products for every aisle of the grocery store, from fresh produce to household goods, including within our private label portfolio. C&S operates more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores primarily under the banners: D&W® Fresh Market, Grand Union®, Family Fare®, Martin’s™ Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly®. C&S is deeply committed to corporate citizenship, actively supporting various charitable causes that help enrich and feed our communities. For more detailed information, please visit our website at cswg.com.
